note: Curated demo knowledge base for two models. Likely causes are common impact/wear patterns, not a diagnosis. Checks reference the owner's manual; a physical inspection decides.

likelyCauses: Low-speed parking or traffic impact (most common)
Clip or bracket fatigue after an earlier repair
whatToCheck: Bumper clip tabs and mounting brackets behind the cover
Fog lamp and parking-sensor connectors if fitted
Panel gap against the fender and headlamp

likelyCauses: Water ingress through a cracked lens or seal
whatToCheck: Correct bulb or LED type for the variant, per the manual
Lens cracks and moisture inside the housing
Connector corrosion and beam aim

likelyCauses: Stone chip thrown up by road traffic
Crack growth from heat or an untreated chip
whatToCheck: Chip size and crack length before it spreads
Rain/light sensor and camera bracket if the variant has ASA
Camera recalibration after replacement on camera-equipped variants

likelyCauses: Car-park door ding or trolley impact
whatToCheck: Whether the paint is cracked — paintless repair only works on intact paint
Door or fender gap alignment and window operation
Rust starting at the dent edge

likelyCauses: Loosened mount from vibration or a knock
whatToCheck: Mirror glass and indicator repeater
Power-fold and adjustment motors
Housing mount and painted cap
Sidewall bulge, cut or exposed cord
Rim runout and balance after impact
Tyre size and pressure per the door-jamb placard; alignment after a hard hit
